title: Mario & Luigi: Bowser's Inside Story
subtitle: An adventure inside the enemy
summary: Mario & Luigi: Bowser's Inside Story is AlphaDream's Nintendo DS role-playing game that makes Bowser both a protagonist and a place to explore. After inhaling Mario and Luigi, he travels through the Mushroom Kingdom while the brothers investigate the world inside his body. Fawful's takeover gives them a common enemy, although Bowser does not understand who is helping him. The two scales of the adventure continually affect one another. An obstacle in the outside world can become a task for the much smaller travellers within.
body: Mario & Luigi: Bowser's Inside Story is AlphaDream's Nintendo DS role-playing game that makes Bowser both a protagonist and a place to explore. After inhaling Mario and Luigi, he travels through the Mushroom Kingdom while the brothers investigate the world inside his body. Fawful's takeover gives them a common enemy, although Bowser does not understand who is helping him. The two scales of the adventure continually affect one another. An obstacle in the outside world can become a task for the much smaller travellers within.

Bowser explores an overhead world and fights with punches, fire and inhaling attacks. Mario and Luigi travel through side-on spaces inside him, using their familiar timed jumps, hammers and coordinated techniques. The DS screens distinguish these viewpoints, with different buttons assigned to the brothers and their enormous host. Enemies inhaled during Bowser's battles can even become opponents for Mario and Luigi. The arrangement makes the hardware's separation useful to the fiction: two related fights can occupy different parts of the same character at the same time.

Some sections ask the brothers to stimulate Bowser's muscles or help him digest what he has eaten. Their small actions change what he can accomplish outside, turning a comic premise into a chain of practical cooperation. New abilities and special attacks provide more ways for both sides to progress. The player alternates between helping Bowser and using the result of that help, so neither viewpoint is merely an interruption. AlphaDream finds an unusually complete role for its unlikely lead: his personality drives the story, while his body supplies its structure.
story_headings: A punch above, a jump below
